props.title: fix width bug
props.patch:
diff --git a/render.go b/render.go
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/render.go
+++ b/render.go
@@ -10,7 +10,8 @@ func Render(spec *Spec) string {
 	w := opts.Width
-	if w < 0 {
+	if w <= 0 {
 		w = 80
 	}
+	c := newCtx(spec, opts)
 	out := c.Node(spec.Root, w)
 	return out
 }
diff --git a/notes.md b/notes.md
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/notes.md
@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+# Notes
+Terminal renderer.
diff --git a/old.txt b/new.txt
similarity index 100%
rename from old.txt
rename to new.txt
